---
title: "6_mlm_models"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(lme4)
library(broom.mixed)
library(lmerTest)
library(car)

rm(list = ls())
```

```{r load BAS data}

bas_rresp <- readRDS("Data/bas.Rds") 

```


### BAS Reward Responsiveness resilience & ELA models (random slopes)


```{r model functions}

model_resilience <- function(df) {
  model <- lmer(rew_resp_modified ~ race_ethnicity + sex + pos_school_env + ps_behav + age + age_sq +
                (1 + age | subjectkey) + (1 | family_id), 
                data = df, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
  
  return(model)
}

resilience_unadjusted <- function(df) {
  model <- lmer(rew_resp_modified ~ pos_school_env + ps_behav + age + age_sq +
                (1 + age | subjectkey) + (1 | family_id), 
                data = df, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
  
  return(model)
}

model_adversity<- function(df) {
  model <- lmer(rew_resp_modified ~ race_ethnicity + sex + cg_psych + ses_dis_nsafety + primary_cg_lack_supp
                + second_cg_lack_supp + yp_family_conflict + cg_sub_use_bio_sep + family_anger_arg + family_aggression
                + trauma_exposure + lack_supervision + age + age_sq +
                (1 + age | subjectkey) + (1 | family_id), 
                data = df, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
  
  return(model)
}

adversity_unadjusted <- function(df) {
  model <- lmer(rew_resp_modified ~ cg_psych + ses_dis_nsafety + primary_cg_lack_supp
                + second_cg_lack_supp + yp_family_conflict + cg_sub_use_bio_sep + family_anger_arg + family_aggression
                + trauma_exposure + lack_supervision + age + age_sq +
                (1 + age | subjectkey) + (1 | family_id), 
                data = df, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
  
  return(model)
}

```

```{r run and pool models}

mod_adversity <- lapply(bas_rresp, model_adversity)  
pooled_mod_adversity <- mod_adversity %>% as.mira() %>% pool()
results_adversity <- broom.mixed::tidy(pooled_mod_adversity, conf.int = TRUE)

mod_resilience <- lapply(bas_rresp, model_resilience)  
pooled_mod_resilience <- mod_resilience %>% as.mira() %>% pool()
results_resilience <- broom.mixed::tidy(pooled_mod_resilience, conf.int = TRUE)


saveRDS(mod_adversity, file = "BAS_adversity_rs.Rds") 

saveRDS(results_adversity, file = "BAS_adversity_rs_tidy.Rds") 

saveRDS(mod_resilience, file = "BAS_resilience_rs.Rds") 

saveRDS(results_resilience, file = "BAS_resilience_rs_tidy.Rds") 

```


```{r unadjusted models}

adversity_unadjusted <- lapply(bas_rresp, adversity_unadjusted)  
pooled_adversity_unadjusted <- adversity_unadjusted %>% as.mira() %>% pool()
results_adversity_unadjusted <- broom.mixed::tidy(pooled_adversity_unadjusted, conf.int = TRUE)

resilience_unadjusted <- lapply(bas_rresp, resilience_unadjusted)  
pooled_resilience_unadjusted <- resilience_unadjusted %>% as.mira() %>% pool()
results_resilience_unadjusted <- broom.mixed::tidy(pooled_resilience_unadjusted, conf.int = TRUE)

saveRDS(adversity_unadjusted, file = "BAS_adversity_unadjusted_rs.Rds") 
saveRDS(results_adversity_unadjusted, file = "BAS_adversity_unadjusted_rs_tidy.Rds") 

saveRDS(resilience_unadjusted, file = "BAS_resilience_unadjusted_rs.Rds") 
saveRDS(results_resilience_unadjusted, file = "BAS_resilience_unadjusted_rs_tidy.Rds") 

```

```{r model functions}
model_adversity<- function(df) {
  model <- lmer(putamen_rresp ~ race_ethnicity + sex + cg_psych + ses_dis_nsafety + primary_cg_lack_supp
                + second_cg_lack_supp + yp_family_conflict + cg_sub_use_bio_sep + family_anger_arg + family_aggression
                + trauma_exposure + lack_supervision + age + age_sq +
                (1 | subjectkey) + (1 | family_id) + (1 | site_id), 
                data = df, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
  
  return(model)
}

adversity_unadjusted <- function(df) {
  model <- lmer(putamen_rresp ~ cg_psych + ses_dis_nsafety + primary_cg_lack_supp
                + second_cg_lack_supp + yp_family_conflict + cg_sub_use_bio_sep + family_anger_arg + family_aggression
                + trauma_exposure + lack_supervision + age + age_sq +
                (1 | subjectkey) + (1 | family_id) + (1 | site_id), 
                data = df, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
  
  return(model)
}


```

```{r run models}

mod_adversity <- lapply(fmri_mid, model_adversity)  
pooled_mod_adversity <- mod_adversity %>% as.mira() %>% pool()
results_adversity <- broom.mixed::tidy(pooled_mod_adversity, conf.int = TRUE)

mod_resilience <- lapply(fmri_mid, model_resilience)  
pooled_mod_resilience <- mod_resilience %>% as.mira() %>% pool()
results_resilience <- broom.mixed::tidy(pooled_mod_resilience, conf.int = TRUE)

saveRDS(mod_adversity, file = "Putamen_rresp_MIDqc_adversity_3lvl.Rds") 

saveRDS(results_adversity, file = "Putamen_rresp_MIDqc_adversity_3lvl_tidy.Rds") 

saveRDS(mod_resilience, file = "Putamen_rresp_MIDqc_resilience_3lvl.Rds") 

saveRDS(results_resilience, file = "Putamen_rresp_MIDqc_resilience_3lvl_tidy.Rds") 

## unadjusted models

adversity_unadjusted <- lapply(fmri_mid, adversity_unadjusted)  
pooled_adversity_unadjusted <- adversity_unadjusted %>% as.mira() %>% pool()
results_adversity_unadjusted <- broom.mixed::tidy(pooled_adversity_unadjusted, conf.int = TRUE)

resilience_unadjusted <- lapply(fmri_mid, resilience_unadjusted)  
pooled_resilience_unadjusted <- resilience_unadjusted %>% as.mira() %>% pool()
results_resilience_unadjusted <- broom.mixed::tidy(pooled_resilience_unadjusted, conf.int = TRUE)

saveRDS(adversity_unadjusted, file = "Putamen_rresp_MIDqc_adversityunadjusted_3lvl.Rds") 

saveRDS(results_adversity_unadjusted, file = "Putamen_rresp_MIDqc_adversityunadjusted_3lvl_tidy.Rds") 

saveRDS(resilience_unadjusted, file = "Putamen_rresp_MIDqc_resilienceunadjusted_3lvl.Rds") 

saveRDS(results_resilience_unadjusted, file = "Putamen_rresp_MIDqc_resilienceunadjusted_3lvl_tidy.Rds")
```
